definition_en: To stop working (machine); to lose control of feelings.
example_en: Our car broke down on the way.

definition_en: To raise a child; to mention a topic.
example_en: She was brought up by her grandmother.

definition_en: To reach the same level as others.
example_en: He studied hard to catch up with the class.
example_uz: U sinfga yetib olish uchun qattiq o'qidi.

definition_en: To handle a problem or situation.
example_en: Teachers deal with many problems daily.
example_uz: O'qituvchilar har kuni ko'p muammolarni hal qiladi.

definition_en: To finally be in a place or situation.
example_en: We ended up staying home.

definition_en: To complete a form with information.
example_en: Fill in this form please.

definition_en: To have a good relationship.
example_en: I get along well with my neighbours.

definition_en: To collect someone; to learn without effort.
example_en: I'll pick you up at seven.

definition_en: To start a business; to arrange equipment.
example_en: They set up a small company.

definition_en: To exercise; to find a solution.
example_en: He works out three times a week.
example_uz: U haftada uch marta mashq qiladi.

headword: hit the nail on the head
definition_en: To say exactly the right thing.
ipa: hɪt ðə neɪl ɒn ðə hed
example_en: Your answer hit the nail on the head.

definition_en: Something bad that turns out to be good.
example_en: Losing that job was a blessing in disguise.
example_uz: U ishdan ketish aslida yaxshilik bo'lib chiqdi.

definition_en: To do something cheaply or carelessly.
example_en: Don't cut corners on safety.

definition_en: To become impossible to control.
example_en: The party got out of hand.

definition_en: To miss an opportunity.
example_en: Buy the tickets now or you'll miss the boat.
example_uz: Chiptalarni hozir oling aks holda imkoniyatni boy berasiz.

definition_en: Unable to decide between two options.
example_en: I'm still on the fence about the trip.

definition_en: The final problem that makes you give up.
example_en: The broken lift was the last straw.

definition_en: To face something unpleasant with courage.
example_en: I bit the bullet and went to the dentist.
example_uz: Tishni tishga qo'yib tish shifokoriga bordim.

definition_en: To stop working for the day.
example_en: We're tired — let's call it a day.

headword: kill two birds with one stone
translation_uz: bir o'q bilan ikki quyonni urmoq
definition_en: To achieve two things with one action.
ipa: kɪl tuː bɜːdz wɪð wʌn stəʊn
example_en: Walking to work kills two birds with one stone.
example_uz: Ishga piyoda borish bir o'q bilan ikki quyonni uradi.
